risk_if_not_implemented: Without Purging AI Agent Data, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Data Loss / Integrity Compromise (R-BC-2), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), AI Data Confidentiality / Integrity / Provenance Loss (R-AI-2), Loss of Data / Service Availability (R-IP-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Purging AI Agent Data (AAT-39.16) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Least Privilege
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions.
compensating_control_2.justification: Least Privilege (IAC-30) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Purging AI Agent Data (AAT-39.16) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
